title: Media Server Architecture Progress Map
problem: Nako has detailed ADRs and workstreams, but lacks one current architecture map that shows the future media-server target, current progress, and next architectural pressure points.

evidence.summary: Reviewed existing architecture authority and froze this as a documentation-only progress-map lane.

Added docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as the top-level media-server system map and docs/architecture deep dives for playback, storage/VFS, library pipeline, state/access, realtime/sync, operations/release, and control plane.
Added ADR 0052 to record the FFmpeg CLI-first HLS runtime and media-engine boundary.
Updated indexes and roadmap, recorded evidence, and closed the lane.
Added the application control-plane architecture deep dive and ADR 0053 for addon lifecycle, observability, durable jobs, remote access, API scale, and cache-contract boundaries.
Added the architecture workstream link index, kept the top-level architecture map concise, and documented architecture_refs/capability_tags for future workstreams.

continue_policy.notes: The lane is closed. Open focused follow-ons for HLS seek/restart, HDR/subtitle compatibility, richer device profiles, or remote transcode workers.
